name: Ibi-Sekigahara-Yoro Quasi-National Park
nameJa: 揖斐関ヶ原養老国定公園
aliases: 揖斐関ヶ原養老国定公園
description: Quasi-national park of the Ibi mountains, the Sekigahara battlefield plain and Mt. Yoro with its waterfall and park, in western Gifu.
notes: Managed by Gifu. The Sekigahara battle museum and Yoro park are the main visits.
parking: Parking available at major visitor areas (fee varies)
